summary:
Lunar Outpost Mission Trainer is an interactive educational game designed to help students understand the challenges of establishing and maintaining a human outpost on the Moon or Mars. Players take on the role of a mission commander and manage essential resources such as oxygen, food, water, energy, and radiation protection to keep their outpost running for 30 days.

The project addresses the challenge by turning complex space exploration concepts into an engaging and interactive learning experience. Players must make decisions, manage limited resources, and balance different survival needs to successfully complete their mission.

This project is important because it encourages students to explore space science, develop critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, and understand the difficulties astronauts may face during future lunar and Martian missions.
details:
Lunar Outpost Mission Trainer is an interactive educational simulation game that allows users to experience the challenges of managing a human outpost on the Moon or Mars. The player takes the role of a mission commander and must keep the outpost operational for 30 days by making important decisions and managing essential resources.

The game includes resource indicators, mission challenges, and decision-making activities related to power, food, oxygen, and radiation shielding. Players must balance different survival needs and think carefully about their choices to maintain a successful mission.

The main benefit of this project is that it makes complex space exploration concepts easier and more interesting for students. Instead of only reading about space missions, users can actively experience resource management and understand the difficulties of establishing human settlements beyond Earth.

Our intended impact is to encourage interest in space science, promote critical thinking, and develop problem-solving and decision-making skills. It also introduces students to the importance of sustainable resource management in future lunar and Martian exploration.

We developed this project using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Visual Studio Code was used as the development environment, and Live Server was used to test the game during development. GitHub Pages was used to publish the project online so that it can be accessed publicly.

The creative aspect of our project is turning space exploration into an interactive mission experience where users become commanders rather than passive learners. We considered important factors such as limited resources, astronaut survival needs, power management, food availability, and radiation protection.

Overall, Lunar Outpost Mission Trainer combines education, creativity, and interactive gameplay to help students explore the possibilities and challenges of humanity's future in space.
